criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Log start, queue a resolved Promise callback, then log end. Predict and record the order in practice.js and explain why the callback follows synchronous code. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement loadProducts using the example and your local API. Document whether it returns an array or paginated envelope and extract the intended records. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Disable a load button while a request runs and display Loading. Restore the button in finally on both success and failure. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Call a missing local endpoint and a mocked 500 response. Check response.ok and display a useful status-based message without treating the error body as product data. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use local mocks returning invalid JSON and rejecting fetch. Demonstrate both reach the error UI and clear loading state. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use AbortController for a replaced search request. Treat cancellation separately from a server failure; show an older response cannot replace newer search results. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create mock success, empty, delayed and rejected responses locally. Record observed UI states for each so practice and review need no internet. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
